thread:
alex: Postmortem uploaded for the authz incident earlier today. TL;DR: token validation edge-case + a perm-mapping bug caused stale access; audit logging showed gaps during the rollback window. Full writeup: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2024-11-authz-edgecase
incident-bot: Incident report created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1723459999 — severity: P2, status: postmortem
alex: Main follow-ups I want tracked here: 1) token validation harness (unit + integration), 2) perm-mapping guardrails + tests, 3) audit-log hardening + retention check, 4) secrets rotation audit to catch TTL drift. Assign owners/ETS below.
priya: I can own #1 (token validation harness). Estimated 10 business days. Will add tests and a synthetic workload that exercises KV-cache edge cases. :white_check_mark:
marta: I'll take #3 (audit logging). Plan: schema validation for critical events + missing-entry alerts. ETA 5 business days. Need to know current retention policy for infra logs.
kevin: I'll take #4 (secrets rotation audit). I want to add a periodic TTL-check job and a PagerDuty alert if >2% of secrets are older than expected. Also propose KMS integration runbook.
sre-oncall: Noted recurring pattern: we've seen TTL drift + missing log entries in 3 incidents this year. Suggest weekly telemetry query to surface drift before it hits prod. I'll add to oncall checklist.
alex: Great. Assignments and due dates: priya (token harness) due 2024-11-20, marta (audit) due 2024-11-15, kevin (secrets audit) due 2024-11-18. I'll own #2 (perm-mapping guardrails) due 2024-11-17. If anyone needs to shift let me know.
priya: Quick Q — do we want the harness to run in CI or as a separate nightly job? I prefer CI + nightly for longer scenarios.
alex: CI for fast checks + nightly for full KV-cache replay. Add a flag to gate heavy runs: `--nightly-replay`.
priya: Ack. I'll add a `scripts/token-check` harness and a GH action. Draft commands:
```
# quick smoke
scripts/token-check --smoke
# nightly heavy replay
scripts/token-check --nightly-replay --seed=sha
```
marta: For audit schema, do we have an existing spec? If not I'll start a formal schema doc under infra/audit and ping analytics for event owners.
kevin: For secrets: two parts — (A) inventory + TTL scan, (B) rotation automation gaps. I'll open a tracker and a small PoC job:
```
./tools/secret-ttl-scan --org redwood --threshold 60
```
kevin: Also want a short runbook to escalate to Sec if rotation fails 3 times in 24h.
sre-oncall: I'll add a weekly telemetry query to detect missing audit entries. Query template in the runbook channel. Also propose a monthly trend report to catch regression patterns.
alex: Two process asks: 1) link PRs to this thread (or the postmortem) so we can close the loop; 2) we should schedule a 30m follow-up in two weeks to verify fixes and any regressions. I'll create a calendar invite.
priya: Will open the PR today and link here. tagging @marta for any schema changes needed in tests.
marta: I'll pair on the integration tests if needed. Send me the harness prototype, priya.
kevin: Opening the tracker now: https://redwood.internal/trackers/SECRETS-1723. Added initial checklist and owner = kevin.
alex: Thanks. For priorities: token harness (high, prevents regression), perm-guardrails (high), audit alerts (medium), secrets audit (high). If anyone wants to reprioritize ping me.
priya: One more ask — do we want synthetic traffic to include old-token scenarios? That will exercise cache/staleness paths.
alex: Yes include expired/rotated-token cases and concurrent replay. Capture logs to `s3://redwood-test-logs/authz-replays`.
incident-bot: Reminder: follow-up meeting scheduled by alex for 2024-11-30 15:00 UTC. Add notes to the postmortem doc.
kevin: Setting up the TTL-scan job as a k8s CronJob and adding metrics for `secrets_ttl_over_threshold_total`.
sre-oncall: I'll add alerting for `secrets_ttl_over_threshold_total` > 1 in the last 5m to the oncall policy.
alex: Ok looks good — owners, please update this thread when you hit major milestones (PR opened, infra deployed, alerts created). Closing the action assignment phase. :thumbsup:
priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inc/platform/pull/8241 — includes GH action + harness. Will follow up with integration logs.
marta: Audit schema doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit/schema-v2.md — updating tests to assert presence of `token_event_id`.
kevin: CronJob deployed to staging. Adding PD escalation runbook next.
sre-oncall: Added weekly check to oncall playbook and an automated query job. Will report in two weeks.
alex: Nice work everyone. We'll review progress in the follow-up meeting. If anything blocks, call it out in this thread so I can reassign.
